items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: It was a tune that was sent down here for me to record by Lou Chud, I think.

ctx.x: That was a tune, yeah. It was a tune that was sent down here for me to record by Lou Chud, I think. And we did a cover on somebody from Chicago. Who it was, I don't know.
